entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order from about 80 days ago for the AeroStride cycling shoes. What seems to be the issue with them?
They just don't fit right. No matter how I position the cleats or what socks I wear, I'm getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride.

I'm sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me check our return policy for you. Okay, I see here that the shoes were delivered 80 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a refund sounds good. Thank you for that. But you know, I've really been struggling with these, and it's set my training back a bit. Since I have to go through the trouble of sending them back and finding a new pair, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad I could get that return approved for you. I understand your frustration, but our system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on returns due to fit. However, I can send you the return shipping label right now, and the refund will be processed as soon as we receive the shoes.
I see. So no discount code at all? Not even 10% for the trouble with the blisters?

I'm afraid not. My priority is to make this return as smooth as possible for you. I've just emailed you the prepaid shipping label. Once you send the cycling shoes back, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, I guess that's everything. It was worth a shot. Thanks for your help with the return.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
